card.name: Just before a famous person's name
card.fires_on: Small words or punctuation right before a well-known historical figure's name in US history or science text, such as 'succeeded by', 'Birthday of', or 'Dr.'. The next word is expected to be a first name like Harry, John, Martin or Isaac.

modes.label: Succession of presidents
modes.description: Words after 'succeeded by' that lead into the next president's name.
modes.example: Ike was succeeded by<< Democrat>> John Kennedy.

modes.label: Titles and links before Martin Luther King
modes.description: Of, Dr. or similar words leading into a civil rights leader's name.
modes.example: Making the Birthday<< of>> Martin Luther King Jr. a National Holiday

modes.label: Lists of thinkers
modes.description: Commas or descriptors before names of scientists and philosophers.
modes.example: theories by David Hume<<,>> Johann Wolfgang von Goethe, Immanuel
